description: Expander for the Gated Comparator, placed immediately to its right, adding a second random melody output with a polarity switch on each bit

params.text: Adds that bit's weight to the CV outputs in its upper position, subtracts it in the lower, and leaves it out in the centre; bit 1 is worth 1/255th of the scale and each bit above it twice as much
Picks 2V, 4V or 8V as the full range of the CV outputs

outputs.text: The weighted sum of the bits that are set, added and subtracted according to the switches
The weighted sum of the bits that are set with its sign flipped

notes: this expander also works with the Basic, Binary and Dual 8 Step Sequencers and the 8 Step Trigger Sequencer, where the bit that counts as set is the one matching the active step
